metadata.description: hungovercoders engineering standards for AI coding agents: shared skills for commits, pull requests and CI, and a doctor that keeps instructions in the right place

plugins.name: agent-standards
plugins.description: Shared engineering skills: Linear-linked Conventional Commits and draft-first PRs, repo CI setup with one `ci` check, and a doctor that checks agent instructions sit in the right layer. The plugin root is this repo, so skills/ is the plugin's skills directory and a new skill ships with no manifest edit. Codex and Copilot users clone the repo and run task install:skills instead (see docs/install.md).
